note: Declarative content of the C4 transfer bundle (built by scripts/c4/pack_bundle.py). Paths under data_root are relative to the data cache (default data_cache); '@name/...' paths resolve under external_roots (inputs outside data_cache). Data lands at <C4_HOME>/rd/data_cache/<dest> so configs/data_registry.toml resolves unchanged. Hard filter: any path containing a restricted token (holdout, heldout, cal, calibration, cal_split, sealed, chunk5, j4b, inc1) is dropped and the build aborts if one survives in a tar. Reconciled 2026-10-12 against configs/c4_wm.toml + configs/c4_policy.toml (OPS_NOTES section 11).
policy_note: C4 world-model data = native driving + random direct-output CAV actions only (WM_C4_DESIGN 2.5): window policy 'damping' (CIRCLES) is excluded by default; pass --policies to override. The selection lists are the registered c4_wm_lists (tools/make_c4_lists.py), shipped at runs/active/c4_wm_lists (registry dataset c4_wm_lists).
code_allowlist_note: Code-only exceptions to the token filter: merge_cal.py is the merge-zone physics calibration module imported by wms.physics (no calibration-split data). Everything else matching a restricted token is dropped and listed in BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json.

c4_wm_lists.note: The registered C4 WM window lists (registry dataset c4_wm_lists -> runs/active/c4_wm_lists); also the TRAIN start-state source of the policy trainer (see run_policy.sh).

lpwo_v3.note: Only the registered eval-world exclusion list (data.windows.exclude); the lpwo window lists are not used by c4_wm.toml.

sidecars.note: No damping sidecars/pack (pack_damping, identities_damping, overlay_damping are not used by c4_wm.toml). The switching zero-shot guard file is NOT shipped (name contains a restricted token): see OPS_NOTES section 11.

eval_states.note: Gate 1 (action fidelity) state sets, ~0.5 GB; off by default (--groups ...,eval_states).

pack_damping_designed.note: To ship CIRCLES-damping windows (evaluation of designed controllers only), rerun with --policies native,trajectory,damping.
